title: Smiling Female Graduate on Campus, 1966 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white photograph from February 1966 capturing a joyful young woman on her graduation day. She wears a mortarboard, academic gown, and a prominent floral corsage on her collar while beaming at the camera. In the background, grand campus architecture with Romanesque arches and fellow attendees can be seen under bright sunlight.
